capabilities: Search other note bodies for a selected, copied, or auto-extracted phrase
Highlight matched phrases in the current note with a candidate-count badge
Preview destination notes, headings, and excerpts, then insert a heading link
Extract candidate phrases from headings, emphasis, prose, and optional n-grams
Maintain ignore lists, stop words, and manual or learned dictionaries
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Privacy section warns the persistent cache stores search queries, paths, headings, offsets, and mtimes in data.json (not note bodies), and that vault sync tools may include that file. Prereleases are installable via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian links point at note titles, so turning a phrase in your note into a link to the passage inside another note that uses the same wording requires manually finding that passage first.

relations.evidence: Spot Linker and DetailSearch Linker can sit side by side. They answer different questions.

summary: Searches other note bodies for a phrase from the current note, highlights matches, and inserts heading links after previewing destinations.
